english.title: Aid / abet a learner driver to drive on a motorway

additionalkeywords.additionalkeyword: MOTORWAYS TRAFFIC ENGLAND AND WALES REGULATIONS 1982

english.standardoffencewording:
On **(..SPECIFY DATE..) at **(..SPECIFY TOWNSHIP..) aided, abetted, counselled or procured **(..SPECIFY DRIVER..) to drive a motor vehicle, namely **(..SPECIFY VEHICLE MAKE AND INDEX NUMBER..), on the **(..SPECIFY MOTORWAY AND LOCATION..) when

(A)_[he]_
(B)_[she]_

was authorised to drive that vehicle only by virtue of being the holder of a provisional licence
english.legislation: Contrary to regulation 11 of the Motorways Traffic (England and Wales) Regulations 1982, section 17(4) of the Road Traffic Regulation Act 1984,Schedule 2 to the Road Traffic Offenders Act 1988 and section 44(1) of the Magistrates' Courts Act 1980.
